coder_notes: Early Phase 1 pilot: an implantable microdevice releases intratumoral microdoses of ~22 drugs ~3 days before resection to measure local intratumor response (in situ drug sensitivity assay). Coded each released drug as a device-dependent candidate (new_route, intratumoral) per C12, but whether microdose response-testing counts as a pharmacological antitumour candidate is for adjudication (candidate_flag uncertain). Each drug is tested in its own reservoir rather than as a combined regimen; coded experimental_combination because several investigational agents share the single experimental arm. Temozolomide and lomustine are established GBM therapies given by a new (intratumoral) route -> established_therapy_experiment. Opdualag split into nivolumab + relatlimab (fixed_dose_combination true); nivolumab is also listed separately as a single agent. Gabapentin, perampanel, bumetanide, prochlorperazine, vortioxetine and meclofenamate are tested for local intratumor response (antitumour outcome), so coded as candidates rather than supportive. Arm text spells 'Meclofenam'/'TMZ'; interventions text spells 'Meclofenamate'/'Temozolomide'. PTC596 kept as development code (no INN in record). Glioblastoma named in conditions and inclusion; 'Grade IV Glioma' without IDH requirement -> cns5_terminology historical. tumour_pk_planned no: drug diffusion into tumour is mentioned but no concentration measurement is planned. target_engagement_planned yes based on planned measurement of tissue drug effects; it could also be read as response rather than pharmacodynamics.
